title: Leave (Chunin Exam)
body:
Syntax: leave

Description: Voluntarily exits the Forest of Death back to your village, without finishing or forfeiting the Chunin Exam. Any scrolls you've collected and your exam progress are unaffected -- 'exam' takes you right back to the entrance whenever you're ready to continue. Only works while actually in the exam.

Date: 2026-08-17
